body.title: Welcome to Chapter 4 Season 2!
body.message: Chapter 4 Season 2 is finally here! Jump into a brand-new season of Flare featuring fresh content, new challenges, exciting rewards and much more. Gear up, squad up and get ready for a new adventure!

body.title: Chapter 4 Season 2 Is Live!
body.message: The wait is over! Chapter 4 Season 2 is now available in Flare. Explore the latest content, discover new locations, complete seasonal challenges and unlock exclusive rewards throughout the season.

body.title: New Season, New Rewards
body.message: A brand-new Battle Pass experience awaits you! Earn XP, complete challenges and unlock a collection of seasonal rewards as you progress through Chapter 4 Season 2.

body.title: Discover the New Battle Pass
body.message: The Chapter 4 Season 2 Battle Pass is here! Unlock new cosmetics, level up throughout the season and discover exclusive rewards waiting for you. How far will you make it?

body.title: Build, Create and Explore
body.message: Ready to create something unique? Explore new creative possibilities in Flare and bring your ideas to life. Build incredible experiences, play with friends and discover what the community has created.

body.title: Performance Improvements
body.message: We've made several improvements to Flare's performance and stability. This update includes optimizations, smoother gameplay and fixes for various issues. Thank you for your continued support!

body.title: A New Era Begins
body.message: Chapter 4 Season 2 marks the beginning of a new era for Flare. More adventures, more challenges and more surprises are waiting for you. Stay tuned for what's coming next!

body.title: Get Ready for the Flare Cup!
body.message: Think you've got what it takes to compete? The Flare Cup is coming soon! Team up, sharpen your skills and prepare for an exciting competitive event. Stay tuned for more details and get ready to prove yourself!
